quotes.text: The source standardized-patient and simulation articles are released by their original authors under Creative Commons licences
no informed consent process was required for the case data

parsed.rationale: Origin (MedEdPORTAL), collection (keyword retrieval of articles), licence terms (CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC0 for sources; CC BY-NC-SA for the dataset) and consent status are all stated. Note: the paper gives the code licence as CC BY-SA while the README states MIT; recorded in the note, score not lowered.
